key.name: password-latin-layout
key.description: When a password field gets focus, switch to a Latin keyboard layout and show which layout is on; switch back when the field loses focus.

key.name: password-preferred-layouts
key.description: XKB layout ids, in order: a password field always switches to the first one that is configured, even from another Latin layout. If none is configured, a Latin layout is kept and a non-Latin one switches to the first Latin layout.

key.name: gloxi-keep-above
key.description: Keep the Gloxi window above all other windows. The Herkos confirmation dialog is always kept above.

key.name: gloxi-panel-edge
key.summary: Keep Gloxi at the right edge of the screen
key.description: Place the Gloxi window at the right edge of the screen, like a side panel, when it appears and when its size changes. Gloxi sets the size.

key.name: gloxi-panel-size
key.description: compact: the last lines of the chat and the input, at the bottom right; one-sixth or one-third: that share of the screen width, the whole height; custom: the size the person gave the window.

key.name: gloxi-dock
key.summary: Reserve a strip of the screen for Gloxi (experimental)
key.description: Reserve a strip at the right edge of the primary monitor for the Gloxi panel, like a dock: maximised windows and notifications stay out of it.
